mapper.select: SELECT k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT kds.STATS_DATE) as mention_days, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_mentions FROM KEYWORD k LEFT JOIN KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds ON k.KEYWORD_ID = kds.KEYWORD_ID WHERE UPPER(k.KEYWORD_NAME) = UPPER(#{keywordName}) GROUP BY k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME

SELECT k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT kds.STATS_DATE) as mention_days, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_mentions FROM KEYWORD k LEFT JOIN KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds ON k.KEYWORD_ID = kds.KEYWORD_ID GROUP BY k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME ORDER BY k.KEYWORD_NAME

SELECT kms.KEYWORD_ID, kms.CURRENT_RANK, TO_CHAR(kms.SHORT_DESCRIPTION) as SHORT_DESCRIPTION, TO_CHAR(kms.TREND_EXPLANATION) as TREND_EXPLANATION, TO_CHAR(kms.MAIN_EMOTIONS) as MAIN_EMOTIONS, kms.CREATED_AT, kms.UPDATED_AT FROM KEYWORD_MAIN_STATS kms WHERE kms.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} ORDER BY kms.UPDATED_AT DESC

SELECT t.rn AS "ranking", t.keyword_name AS "name", t.total_count AS "count", CASE WHEN t.rn = 1 THEN '#e60000' WHEN t.rn <= 3 THEN '#ff6600' WHEN t.rn <= 7 THEN '#000000' ELSE '#0044ff' END AS "color" FROM ( SELECT keyword_name, SUM(NVL(daily_count, 0)) AS total_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(NVL(daily_count, 0)) DESC) AS rn FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS WHERE keyword_name IS NOT NULL AND daily_count > 0 GROUP BY keyword_name ) t WHERE t.keyword_name = #{keywordName}

SELECT seq_no AS rank, keyword_name AS name, total_count AS count, '↔' AS trend, CASE WHEN seq_no = 1 THEN '#e60000' WHEN seq_no <= 3 THEN '#ff6600' WHEN seq_no <= 7 THEN '#000000' ELSE '#0044ff' END AS color FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(NVL(daily_count, 0)) DESC) AS seq_no, keyword_name, SUM(NVL(daily_count, 0)) AS total_count FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS WHERE keyword_name IS NOT NULL AND daily_count > 0 GROUP BY keyword_name ) ORDER BY seq_no

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ks.ID, ks.INPUT_ID, ks.SIMILAR_1_ID, ks.SIMILAR_2_ID, ks.SIMILAR_3_ID, ks.SIMILAR_4_ID, ks.SIMILAR_5_ID, TO_CHAR(ks.REASON) as REASON, k1.KEYWORD_NAME as similar_1_name, k2.KEYWORD_NAME as similar_2_name, k3.KEYWORD_NAME as similar_3_name, k4.KEYWORD_NAME as similar_4_name, k5.KEYWORD_NAME as similar_5_name FROM KEYWORD_SIMILARITY ks LEFT JOIN KEYWORD k1 ON ks.SIMILAR_1_ID = k1.KEYWORD_ID AND ks.SIMILAR_1_ID != 0 LEFT JOIN KEYWORD k2 ON ks.SIMILAR_2_ID = k2.KEYWORD_ID AND ks.SIMILAR_2_ID != 0 LEFT JOIN KEYWORD k3 ON ks.SIMILAR_3_ID = k3.KEYWORD_ID AND ks.SIMILAR_3_ID != 0 LEFT JOIN KEYWORD k4 ON ks.SIMILAR_4_ID = k4.KEYWORD_ID AND ks.SIMILAR_4_ID != 0 LEFT JOIN KEYWORD k5 ON ks.SIMILAR_5_ID = k5.KEYWORD_ID AND ks.SIMILAR_5_ID != 0 WHERE ks.INPUT_ID = #{keywordId} ORDER BY ks.ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as total_mentions FROM KEYWORD k LEFT JOIN KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds ON k.KEYWORD_ID = kds.KEYWORD_ID WHERE UPPER(k.KEYWORD_NAME) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{query} || '%') GROUP BY k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME ORDER BY total_mentions DESC NULLS LAST, k.KEYWORD_NAME ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME, NVL(SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT), 0) as total_mentions, NVL(COUNT(DISTINCT kds.STATS_DATE), 0) as mention_days FROM KEYWORD k LEFT JOIN KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds ON k.KEYWORD_ID = kds.KEYWORD_ID AND kds.STATS_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30 GROUP BY k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME ORDER BY total_mentions DESC, k.KEYWORD_NAME ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 20

SELECT k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as TOTAL_MENTIONS, COUNT(DISTINCT kds.STATS_DATE) as MENTION_DAYS FROM KEYWORD k LEFT JOIN KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds ON k.KEYWORD_ID = kds.KEYWORD_ID WHERE k.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} AND k.KEYWORD_ID != 0 GROUP BY k.KEYWORD_ID, k.KEYWORD_NAME

choose.when: WITH LAST_MENTION AS ( SELECT MAX(kds.STATS_DATE) as last_date FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds WHERE kds.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} AND kds.DAILY_COUNT > 0 ) SELECT TRUNC(kds.STATS_DATE, 'MM') as STATS_DATE, SUM(kds.DAILY_COUNT) as DAILY_COUNT, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(kds.STATS_DATE, 'MM'), 'MM/DD') as formatted_date, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(kds.STATS_DATE, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as date_string FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds, LAST_MENTION lm WHERE kds.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} AND kds.STATS_DATE >= ADD_MONTHS(lm.last_date, -6) AND kds.STATS_DATE <= lm.last_date GROUP BY TRUNC(kds.STATS_DATE, 'MM'), TO_CHAR(TRUNC(kds.STATS_DATE, 'MM'), 'MM/DD'), TO_CHAR(TRUNC(kds.STATS_DATE, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY TRUNC(kds.STATS_DATE, 'MM') ASC
choose.otherwise:
WITH LAST_MENTION AS ( SELECT MAX(kds.STATS_DATE) as last_date FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds WHERE kds.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} AND kds.DAILY_COUNT > 0 ) SELECT kds.STATS_DATE, kds.DAILY_COUNT, TO_CHAR(kds.STATS_DATE, 'MM/DD') as formatted_date, TO_CHAR(kds.STATS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as date_string FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds, LAST_MENTION lm WHERE kds.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} AND kds.STATS_DATE >=
lm.last_date - 1
lm.last_date - 6
lm.last_date - 6
lm.last_date - 364
lm.last_date - 6
AND kds.STATS_DATE <= lm.last_date ORDER BY kds.STATS_DATE ASC

mapper.select: SELECT MAX(kds.STATS_DATE) as LAST_DATE FROM KEYWORD_DAILY_STATS kds WHERE kds.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} AND kds.DAILY_COUNT > 0

SELECT sr.LABEL AS emotion_label, CASE WHEN sr.LABEL IN ('환영/호의','감동/감탄','고마움','존경','기대감','뿌듯함', '편안/쾌적','신기함/관심','아껴주는','즐거움/신남','깨달음', '흐뭇함(귀여움/예쁨)','놀람','행복','기쁨','안심/신뢰') THEN 'positive' WHEN sr.LABEL IN ('불평/불만','지긋지긋','슬픔','화남/분노','우쭐댐/무시함', '안타까움/실망','비장함','의심/불신','부끄러움','공포/무서움', '절망','한심함','역겨움/징그러움','짜증','어이없음','패배/자기혐오', '귀찮음','힘듦/지침','죄책감','증오/혐오','당황/난처','경악', '부담/안_내킴','서러움','재미없음','불쌍함/연민','불안/걱정') THEN 'negative' ELSE 'neutral' END AS sentiment_type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM SENTIMENT_RESULT sr WHERE ( -- Instagram 댓글 (COMMENT_ID가 NUMBER이므로 직접 비교) EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTAGRAM_COMMENT ic JOIN INSTAGRAM_POST ip ON ic.POST_ID = ip.POST_ID WHERE ip.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} AND ic.COMMENT_ID = sr.SOURCE_ID ) OR -- YouTube 댓글 (COMMENT_ID가 VARCHAR2이므로 NUMBER로 변환해서 비교) EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM YOUTUBE_COMMENT yc JOIN YOUTUBE_VIDEO yv ON yc.VIDEO_ID = yv.VIDEO_ID WHERE yv.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} AND TO_NUMBER(yc.COMMENT_ID) = sr.SOURCE_ID ) ) AND sr.SOURCE_TYPE = 'comments' AND sr.LABEL IN ('환영/호의','감동/감탄','고마움','존경','기대감','뿌듯함', '편안/쾌적','신기함/관심','아껴주는','즐거움/신남','깨달음', '흐뭇함(귀여움/예쁨)','놀람','행복','기쁨','안심/신뢰', '불평/불만','지긋지긋','슬픔','화남/분노','우쭐댐/무시함', '안타까움/실망','비장함','의심/불신','부끄러움','공포/무서움', '절망','한심함','역겨움/징그러움','짜증','어이없음','패배/자기혐오', '귀찮음','힘듦/지침','죄책감','증오/혐오','당황/난처','경악', '부담/안_내킴','서러움','재미없음','불쌍함/연민','불안/걱정') GROUP BY sr.LABEL, CASE WHEN sr.LABEL IN ('환영/호의','감동/감탄','고마움','존경','기대감','뿌듯함', '편안/쾌적','신기함/관심','아껴주는','즐거움/신남','깨달음', '흐뭇함(귀여움/예쁨)','놀람','행복','기쁨','안심/신뢰') THEN 'positive' WHEN sr.LABEL IN ('불평/불만','지긋지긋','슬픔','화남/분노','우쭐댐/무시함', '안타까움/실망','비장함','의심/불신','부끄러움','공포/무서움', '절망','한심함','역겨움/징그러움','짜증','어이없음','패배/자기혐오', '귀찮음','힘듦/지침','죄책감','증오/혐오','당황/난처','경악', '부담/안_내킴','서러움','재미없음','불쌍함/연민','불안/걱정') THEN 'negative' ELSE 'neutral' END HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY sentiment_type DESC, count DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.* FROM ( -- YouTube SELECT DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.COMMENT_TEXT, 4000, 1) AS comment_text, c.COMMENT_ID AS comment_id, 'youtube' AS source_type FROM YOUTUBE_VIDEO v JOIN YOUTUBE_COMMENT c ON c.VIDEO_ID = v.VIDEO_ID WHERE v.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} AND DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(c.COMMENT_TEXT) >= 15
UNION ALL
-- Instagram SELECT DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.COMMENT_TEXT, 4000, 1) AS comment_text, TO_CHAR(c.COMMENT_ID) AS comment_id, 'instagram' AS source_type FROM INSTAGRAM_POST p JOIN INSTAGRAM_COMMENT c ON c.POST_ID = p.POST_ID WHERE p.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} AND DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(c.COMMENT_TEXT) >= 15 ) t ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= NVL(#{limit}, 3)

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM YOUTUBE_VIDEO WHERE KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId}) AS youtube_videos, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INSTAGRAM_POST WHERE KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId}) AS instagram_posts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM YOUTUBE_COMMENT yc JOIN YOUTUBE_VIDEO yv ON yc.VIDEO_ID = yv.VIDEO_ID WHERE yv.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId}) AS youtube_comments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INSTAGRAM_COMMENT ic JOIN INSTAGRAM_POST ip ON ic.POST_ID = ip.POST_ID WHERE ip.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId}) AS instagram_comments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SENTIMENT_RESULT WHERE SOURCE_TYPE = 'comments') AS total_sentiment_results FROM DUAL

SELECT COMMENT_TEXT, '${emotion}' as EMOTION, PLATFORM FROM ( -- YouTube 댓글 2개 SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(yc.COMMENT_TEXT, 100, 1) as COMMENT_TEXT, 'YouTube' as PLATFORM FROM YOUTUBE_COMMENT yc JOIN YOUTUBE_VIDEO yv ON yc.VIDEO_ID = yv.VIDEO_ID WHERE yv.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} AND yc.EMOTIONS IS NOT NULL AND INSTR(yc.EMOTIONS, '${emotion}') > 0 AND DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(yc.COMMENT_TEXT) >= 15 ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 2
UNION ALL
-- Instagram 댓글 2개 SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(ic.COMMENT_TEXT, 100, 1) as COMMENT_TEXT, 'Instagram' as PLATFORM FROM INSTAGRAM_COMMENT ic JOIN INSTAGRAM_POST ip ON ic.POST_ID = ip.POST_ID WHERE ip.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} AND ic.EMOTIONS IS NOT NULL AND INSTR(ic.EMOTIONS, '${emotion}') > 0 AND DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(ic.COMMENT_TEXT) >= 15 ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 2 ) ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE

choose.when: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(ic.COMMENT_TEXT, 100, 1) as COMMENT_TEXT, '${emotion}' as EMOTION, 'Instagram' as PLATFORM FROM INSTAGRAM_COMMENT ic JOIN INSTAGRAM_POST ip ON ic.POST_ID = ip.POST_ID WHERE ip.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} AND ic.EMOTIONS IS NOT NULL AND INSTR(ic.EMOTIONS, '${emotion}') > 0 AND DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(ic.COMMENT_TEXT) >= 15 ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(yc.COMMENT_TEXT, 100, 1) as COMMENT_TEXT, '${emotion}' as EMOTION, 'YouTube' as PLATFORM FROM YOUTUBE_COMMENT yc JOIN YOUTUBE_VIDEO yv ON yc.VIDEO_ID = yv.VIDEO_ID WHERE yv.KEYWORD_ID = #{keywordId} AND yc.EMOTIONS IS NOT NULL AND INSTR(yc.EMOTIONS, '${emotion}') > 0 AND DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(yc.COMMENT_TEXT) >= 15 ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
